scope: Windows SolokPDF form text/search invalidation; shared engine/cache/search implementation

cases: Both engines: prewarmed display/editor caches on edited and calculated pages
In-place text UI commit; floating search count 0 -> 2 -> 0 -> 2

Rejected validation with a committed side effect on another page
Repeated query, FindNext, glyph selection, Undo and Redo

limits: No Release build, full suite or ng build/GUI test

E35/E36 acceptance, dirty-state and refresh-error reporting remain open
